summary: First-run full-stack test of Elite AI Basketball Coach. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases green after fixing one production bug (str.format() KeyError on FORM_SYSTEM/VIDEO_SYSTEM due to JSON braces). Frontend: login -> dashboard -> shot tracker (zone select + make/miss) -> AI coach preset + reply + TTS -> training plan generate -> skill library + skill detail (YouTube iframe) -> pressure mode UI -> player lab (20 seed players) -> achievements (badges rendered, First Step unlocked) -> weekly report. All critical flows worked end-to-end.
action_items: None blocking. (Fixed) FORM_SYSTEM/VIDEO_SYSTEM used str.format() but string body contained literal JSON braces (e.g. '{"confidence":...}') which raised KeyError before image ever reached Claude. Changed to str.replace() for {mode}/{n}.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, coach, shots, media, tts, etc.) once feature-complete.
put_object/get_object are sync 'requests' calls executed inside async endpoints; large uploads will block the event loop. Consider running via asyncio.to_thread or httpx.AsyncClient.
compute_streak/shot_stats pull all docs into memory (to_list 2000/5000). Fine for MVP; add Mongo aggregations before scale.
TTS cache stores audio bytes base64 in Mongo which can bloat the collection; consider using object storage for audio too, or a size cap / TTL.
GET /players/{pid} treats any unknown slug as an AI lookup (60s+ Claude call). Rate-limit or gate this per user to avoid abuse.
/api/files/{path} accepts token via query string — logs may leak the JWT. Prefer signed short-lived URLs.
shot_stats groups zones case-sensitively (e.g. 'corner-L' vs 'corner-l'); ensure the frontend never mixes casing.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_<uuid>@example.com signup users during testing (onboarding + upload owner-isolation checks). Also inserted synthetic shots, one workout, one challenge, one training plan, ~2 coach messages, and 1 photo/1 video analysis for smoke@test.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If retesting, note that smoke user now has ~16 shots logged, ~6 workouts, 2 films, 4 coach msgs and a 1-day streak from this run. FORM_SYSTEM/VIDEO_SYSTEM were converted from .format() to .replace() due to JSON braces — do not revert. Frontend flows all reachable at BASE=/, /coach, /training, /shots, /skills, /skills/:slug, /pressure, /players, /achievements, /report. AI endpoints (coach, plan, form, video, player-lookup) take 5-25s each — use long timeouts.
rca of the issue: FORM_SYSTEM / VIDEO_SYSTEM strings contain the target JSON schema as literal text with '{' and '}' characters. Python's str.format(mode=..) parses every {segment} as a field, so it saw {"confidence"...} and threw KeyError('"confidence"') before any AI call. All /api/analyze/form and /api/analyze/video requests returned 500/502. Mitigation: replaced .format() with .replace() for the {mode} and {n} placeholders since the surrounding text intentionally contains JSON braces.
